question.text: Performance fee per HWM principle: Year 1 fee of Rs. 10 lakh paid on Rs. 1.2 crore peak. Year 2 portfolio falls to Rs. 1.0 crore. Year 2 performance fee:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** HWM at Rs. 1.2 crore; value below => no performance fee. **The Trap:** Charging below HWM double-counts. **Cross-Exam Context:** Workbook HWM example. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Roll HWM forward only when new peak achieved.
